note: Gameplay progression proposal for regions 1 to 10. Design data only; no game code changed.

levelRule.elite: Greenvale: ordinary max; from region 2: bossLv
levelRule.extension: Regions 3 to 10 add 5 boss levels each (16 to 55), sub-area boss levels non-decreasing with repeats; w(L) = (L/5)^1.5 continues (needs validation past Lv15)

1.elements: Wood, Water, Earth, Wind pips; Storm at the finale
1.keywords: armor, barrel, Guarded, Mirage, Thorn, Stride/Tide, Healer, Fuse, Bulwark, Summoner, Regrow, Splitter
1.units: Straight, Spread, Pierce, Boost, Shield as pure roles; Swift, Pounce; family sets at 2
1.evolution: Stage 1 animals; a shrine shows one run-only evolution
1.rend: First Fangs unit in the first reward; Rend on Piggyback; Bulwark (Ruins) stops Rend and Pierce

2.reactions: Mud (Palms), Smother (Wadi, a warning), Fan (Erg), Purge and Dusk (Tomb), Sunfire (Citadel) = 6, total 10
2.keywords: Chief, Skewer, Grudge, Leech, Ghost, armor 2
2.units: First hybrids (Guard plus Attack), Captains, Decoy, Skyfall, Herald
2.evolution: Stage 2 (Mastery 3, 2 stars) reachable; shrines evolve one unit per run
2.rend: Rend against armor 2; Whetstone Camp upgrade after Ashkara

3.keywords: Harden, Regenerate, Alpha, Skeleton rise, stronger Guarded, Sweep
3.units: Chill, Hold, Mark, Howl, Carapace; resonance at 4
3.rend: Hunter's Moon offered (Fangs Rend cap 4); Rend against Harden

4.reactions: Ground = 1, total 14; Smother and Steam used in earnest
4.keywords: Fury, Enrage, Gaze, Regrow sealed by Burn, Skewer, Bulwark walls
4.units: Scorch, Trample, Pounce, Echo; Bastion in the front row
4.rend: Rend plus Spill against Bulwark; Whetstone +1 cap

5.reactions: Mist = 1, total 15; Wet then Storm then Freeze chains
5.keywords: Tide, Swarm, Summoner again, Hold, Veiled, Stride
5.units: Chain, Current, Row Captain, Fins sets, Bloom
5.rend: Rend through swarms of small bodies

6.reactions: Pollen = 1, total 16; Wildfire chains on full Wood rows
6.keywords: Hide, Grudge, Corrupted, Swarm plus Summoner, Regrow plus Healer
6.units: Brood, Offering, Molt, Relay, Mentor, Herald
6.rend: Rend cap 4 helps break Hide with big hits

7.reactions: none new; Purge and Mist revisited
7.keywords: Ghost, Leech, stronger Gaze, Shapeshift/Mimic, flicker Veiled, Deathless
7.units: Attune, Mimic, Swap; Ward and Rebirth appear
7.rend: Rend cannot cross Ghost: Purge first

8.reactions: none new; Sunfire, Dusk, Smother in a dense castle
8.keywords: Bulwark, Guarded, Healer, Chief, Harden in formation
8.units: Mirror, Echo Drum, Relay, Bastion, Ward
8.rend: Wall exam: Rend, Pierce and Sunder against Bulwark

9.keywords: Stride, Veiled, Sweep, Healer in the open, Crystal shards
9.units: Skyfall, Spyglass, Wings sets of 4; Legendary born mythic

10.elements: Light and Shadow at depth; every element
10.reactions: none new; every reaction in one hour
10.keywords: all, plus element resistance on elites and bosses (open)
10.units: Legendary hubs, Rebirth and Ward, full builds
10.evolution: All lines; Seals of every element
10.rend: Rend cap 4 plus Whetstone against late walls

teaches: Light and Shadow pips at depth; Purge and Dusk
